pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test 'AC-1' checks seeded rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
test 'AC-2' covers / and /?view=open in id order with one item done.
test 'AC-3' checks done-only, ✓ prefix, id order (marked 3,1).
test 'AC-4' checks all items in id order with ✓ only on done.
test 'AC-5' checks exact nav HTML for each view and default.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__.

The code behaves correctly and the test body checks the messages, but the final commit fc6542f removed 'AC-7' from the test title, so no test names AC-7 and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'. Under the naming rule it is unmet.
test 'AC-8' asserts routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all; traffic/routes.json updated.

findings.what: Commit fc6542f ('Follow-up edits', by a bot) renamed the AC-7 test to 'an empty table says so in every view; an empty view has its own message'. No test now names AC-7, and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'.

The PR body says test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8. That is no longer true after fc6542f, because the AC-7 label was removed. The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is also questionable, since a late commit edited the test.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-7 label, or correct the PR body.

findings.what: The states tests for 'Nothing open' and 'Nothing done' only check the message and the list. They do not check the current-view marker (Open or Done) that the state table lists. The 'Empty table' state is tested only on the default view.
findings.fix: Assert the <strong> current-view marker in those tests.

lenses.note: The spec exists with an owner go dated 2026-10-12. Both decisions are followed: the default view is open and the view is a query parameter.
AC-7 is unnamed by any test after the last commit. The other items are met.
The tests assert behaviour. I did not run them (the Cloudflare vitest pool may be unavailable here); CI runs them.
The README describes the views. The spec and migration are consistent with the code.

The view is looked up with Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ cannot slip through. The query string is not interpolated into the SQL, only fixed WHERE fragments are. The extra COUNT query is only used when a view is empty.
The title is escaped by escapeHtml. The view value is validated against a whitelist and never echoed. No planted instructions found. The 'Follow-up edits' commit is by a bot and only renames a test.
The diff changes the HTML produced by src/index.js only as a plain nav and list, with no UI framework or style files. Treated as no designed UI.
No UI flow or screenshots are available, and the PR states there is no browser in the session.
The claim that done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8 is false at head. Other claims match the diff.
